2026-11-23.note: Full effort starts today: small exercises to failure, big ones stop 1 rep before.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Stay at 37.5 kg and go for 10: you got 8 on all four sets.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: every set reached 12 at 20 kg.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 15: you got 14 on every set, one rep from the step.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Stay at 10 kg and go for 15: 12 on every set, no shoulder pain.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: All sets at 5 kg with no pin, aim for 14: 5 kg gave 12 a side, 10 kg only 7.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on all four sets.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again, go for 12 on every set, then add the first pair of plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Stay at 20 kg on the cable: the first set gave only 6, so get 10 on every set first.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on every set.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow, aim for 12; stop if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on both sets.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight, go for 12: you got 10 on both sets.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: start with the empty bar or a light Smith bar, and add plates only if 10 reps come easily.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: 12.5 kg dumbbells, aim for 8: 15 kg gave only 5 and Push B asks 8 to 12; use 12 kg if there is no 12.5.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25, over the top of the range.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips, leaning forward; if 8 is not there, use the chest press machine at a weight you lift 10 times.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick a weight a bit under your 25 kg pushdown, about 15 to 20 kg, that you lift 12 times with 2 left.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin, the lightest plate, aim for 15 with slow reps: you got 12 there on Pull A.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time on this line: your Pull A pulldown was 37.5 kg for 8, so pick 30 to 35 kg here for 8 to 12.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you lift 10 times with 2 left; your cable row did 20 kg for 12.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: a dumbbell you lift 12 times with 2 left, about 12.5 to 15 kg; start with the left arm.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: light, about 10 kg on the rope, aim for 15 to 20 with a pause at the face.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin, aim for 14: 5 kg gave 12 a side on Pull A.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: hammer curls are stronger than your 5 kg incline curl, so try 7.5 kg for 10 to 15.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: light dumbbells, about 5 kg each, 8 to 12 a leg; start with the left leg and stop if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: start light, about 20 to 30 kg, and pick the weight you lift 10 times with 2 left.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on every set.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight you lift 15 times with 2 left, slow at the bottom.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight with straighter legs than the knee raise; bend the knees a little if 10 is not there.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and go for 6: you got 5 and 5; if 5 again, drop to 12.5 kg on every set.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg and go for 10: you got 8 on every set.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg with no pin, aim for 14: you got 12 a side there on Pull A.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Stay at 30 kg until 12 on both sets: the second set gave 8.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Stay at 25 kg and go for 12: you got 10 on all four sets.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25, over the top of the range.
